workflowName: CDF Council Technical and Safeguards Appraisal
escalationTrigger: Design, cost, land, safeguards, budget or legal evidence is incomplete
escalationOwner: Council Town Planning Officer and Provincial Local Government Officer
purpose: Verify feasibility, design, site, safeguards, budget and legal readiness before a CDF project proceeds.
institution: Local Authority Technical, Planning, Finance, Legal and Safeguards Units

steps.name: Validate site and feasibility
steps.explanation: Confirm land, location, design feasibility, beneficiaries and implementation constraints.
steps.requiredEvidence: Site assessment, design and feasibility report

steps.name: Review safeguards and legal readiness
steps.explanation: Check environmental, social, land, accessibility and legal requirements.
steps.requiredEvidence: Safeguards screening, land evidence and legal review

steps.name: Confirm cost and budget match
steps.explanation: Match estimate, bill of quantities, funding envelope and delivery plan.
steps.requiredEvidence: Cost estimate, BOQ, budget match and appraisal decision

rules.explanation: A council appraisal requires an approved amount and supporting evidence.

escalations.action: Request missing feasibility, safeguards or cost evidence
Escalate unresolved appraisal or legal readiness gap

workflowName: CDF Contract Mobilisation and Variation Control
schedule: Daily contract readiness and variation review
escalationTrigger: Contract, security, site handover, baseline or variation approval evidence is missing
escalationOwner: Council Procurement Officer and Accounting Officer
purpose: Control contract execution, mobilisation, baseline commitments and authorised changes after procurement award.
institution: Local Authority Procurement, Legal, Technical, Finance and Contractor

steps.name: Validate executed contract
steps.explanation: Confirm signatures, security, insurance, scope, milestones and authorised parties.
steps.requiredEvidence: Executed contract, security and insurance evidence

steps.name: Confirm mobilisation and baseline
steps.explanation: Record site handover, work plan, baseline cost, schedule and reporting obligations.
steps.requiredEvidence: Site handover, mobilisation plan and baseline

steps.name: Assess variation or extension
steps.explanation: Test technical basis, cost, time, budget and approval authority before any change.
steps.requiredEvidence: Variation request, technical report, cost impact and decision

rules.explanation: A contract variation cannot proceed without configured authority and evidence.

escalationTrigger: Defect, final account, asset register, custodian, audit or complaint evidence remains open
escalationOwner: Council Technical Officer and Internal Audit Officer
purpose: Verify completion, handover, operating sustainability, final account and closure conditions for a CDF project.
institution: Local Authority, Contractor, Custodian, WDC, Community, Province and Ministry

steps.name: Verify completion and defects
steps.explanation: Inspect output, quality, beneficiary acceptance and outstanding defects.
steps.requiredEvidence: Final inspection, completion certificate and community feedback

steps.name: Transfer custody and sustainability plan
steps.explanation: Register the asset, custodian, operating plan, maintenance needs and handover acceptance.
steps.requiredEvidence: Handover certificate, asset record and sustainability plan

steps.name: Reconcile and close journey
steps.explanation: Confirm final account, audit disposition, complaint disposition and closure approval.
steps.requiredEvidence: Final account, audit outcome, complaint status and closure decision

rules.explanation: A CDF journey cannot close while required actions or final-account reconciliation remain open.

escalations.action: Request missing completion or handover evidence
Escalate unresolved closure blocker or final-account issue
